clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away in the southern reaches of Old Town, the Champions' Hall serves as the officer's barracks and supply armory for the Alliance's decorated veterans in Stormwind. Beyond its threshold, quartermasters dispense specialized weapons, plate, and regalia to proven warriors of the faction. Access is strictly guarded, reserved only for officers who have demonstrated valor on the field of war.

Hidden behind a guarded threshold in Old Town, the Champions' Hall is a restricted haven for the Alliance's most distinguished combatants. Military commanders gather here over tactical maps of Azeroth to confer on ongoing campaigns, flanked by armaments and the grand insignias of rank. Only soldiers who have climbed the Alliance hierarchy to achieve officer status—specifically the rank of Knight or higher—are permitted entry. Inside, military quartermasters supply battle-hardened soldiers with elite arms, armor, and mounts crafted specifically to turn the tide against the Horde in contested zones across the world.
